description: This file contains a jQuery plugin for handling AJAX-based form updates ('superform'), including DOM manipulation, event handling, and initialization of datepickers and feedback elements within a specific form structure.

methods.name: _superformUpdateElement
methods.description: Handles the DOM update of a form element by replacing or removing its contents, managing focus, and handling nested elements.

methods.name: _superformUpdate
methods.description: Updates a form element's HTML content based on AJAX response, managing focus and triggering events before and after.

methods.name: superform
methods.description: Main jQuery plugin method to send AJAX requests for form submission and update target elements with server response.
